System OverviewThe BANF (Bengali Association of North Florida) Digital Platform is a community management system built on Wix Velo with an intelligent agent layer. The system processes member communications, manages events, handles payments, and provides administrative tools through a multi-agent architecture.### Architecture Principles| Principle | Description ||-----------|-------------|| Agent Autonomy | Each agent owns its domain and makes decisions independently || YAML Configuration | Drive lifecycle managed through declarative YAML, not code || RL-Driven Learning | Email classifier improves through reinforcement learning feedback || Message Queue | All message processing flows through a queue with dedup + DLQ || Change Management | All changes go through Change Agent ΓåÆ Design Agent ΓåÆ Dev Board || Zero External Deps | Core agents use only Node.js built-ins + local file storage |### High-Level Component Architecture Decision Records### ADR-001: Use Contextual MAB (UCB1) for email action selection- **Status:** accepted- **Date:** 2026-03-09- **Context:** Email classifier was approving spam for president review, wasting time- **Decision:** Implement Contextual Multi-Armed Bandit with UCB1 exploration instead of rule-based filtering- **Rationale:** UCB1 balances exploration/exploitation naturally. No external ML infrastructure needed. Learns from rejection feedback.- **Modules:** rl-engine, user-query-agent, email-reader### ADR-002: File-backed message queue over managed service- **Status:** accepted- **Date:** 2026-03-09- **Context:** Need message queue for email pipeline but Wix has no server access- **Decision:** Use better-queue pattern with JSON file persistence (Phase 1), migrate to BullMQ + Upstash Redis when volume demands it (Phase 2)- **Rationale:** Zero external dependencies for Phase 1. $0 cost. Wix constraints prevent Kafka/RabbitMQ. Upstash free tier (10K cmd/day) covers future needs.- **Modules:** message-queue, email-reader### ADR-003: YAML-driven drive lifecycle over hardcoded config- **Status:** accepted- **Date:** 2026-03-09- **Context:** Drive activation was scattered across code, no central config- **Decision:** Move all drive definitions to banf-drives.yaml with Event Manager Agent owning lifecycle state- **Rationale:** Declarative config separates what from when. Non-developers can understand drive definitions. Agent manages state transitions.- **Modules:** event-manager, banf-drives-yaml, email-reader### ADR-004: Change Agent + Design-Architecture Agent for governance- **Status:** accepted- **Date:** 2026-03-09- **Context:** Dev board had only mock data, no real change tracking or architecture documentation- **Decision:** Create Change Agent for technical review/approval and Design-Architecture Agent for doc maintenance- **Rationale:** Formalizes software engineering process. Stakeholder approval pipeline toggleable by super admin. Auto-generates architecture doc.- **Modules:** change-agent, design-arch-agent, admin-portal### ADR-005: Message queue integrated into email reader pipeline- **Status:** accepted- **Date:** 2026-03-09- **Context:** Each scan phase enqueues emails, ack on success, nack to DLQ on failure- **Decision:** Wrap existing scan/process handlers with MQ enqueue/ack/nack. Non-invasive integration preserving current flow.- **Rationale:** ---## 4. Agent Mesh Architecture| Agent | File | Purpose | Drives Owned ||-------|------|---------|--------------|| Email Reader | bosonto-email-reader-agent.js | Gmail polling, phase orchestration | All phases || Classifier/Query | user-query-agent.js | Email classification, response gen | auto_response || RL Feedback | banf-rl-feedback-engine.js | CMAB/UCB1 action learning | pre-filter || Event Manager | banf-event-manager.js | Drive lifecycle from YAML | event-bound drives || Change Agent | banf-change-agent.js | Technical review, ticket creation | dev board || Design-Arch Agent | banf-design-architecture-agent.js | Architecture doc maintenance | ADRs || Memory RAG | agent-memory-rag.js | Long-term learning storage | knowledge base || Compliance | communication-compliance.js | Email headers, content validation | outbound email || Payment Engine | banf-payment-purpose-engine.js | Payment classification | payment_processing || Delivery Agent | banf-delivery-failure-agent.js | Bounce recovery, escalation | delivery_failure || Message Queue | banf-message-queue.js | FIFO queue with dedup/DLQ | all inbound |---## 7.
